scope: Local PostgreSQL (PGlite), real v13.11 migration/RLS/RPC; no production records

checks.name: starting TPM carries its lead, work plan and start time to the source finding
one TPM completion saves actual zero and closes only its source finding
completion retry is idempotent; a new attempt cannot overwrite a closed TPM
missing verification blocks both TPM and follow-up closure
partial work remains open and does not duplicate the original finding
completed TPM with further work keeps the source open without a duplicate
choosing later verification transfers the work and leaves source awaiting verification
one of multiple linked jobs cannot prematurely close their source
source write failure rolls back execution and job changes together
manual closeout needs owner, work and verification; plan derives from actual work
manual closeout cannot bypass a still active linked TPM
RLS denial of source updates never leaves a completed TPM behind
deletion requires confirmation and preserves all original evidence
deletion rejects unknown types, unknown IDs and foreign departments atomically
deleted TPMs cannot be started or completed
all remaining record types can be hidden without deleting their original rows
PM deletions preserve approved revisions and work-order snapshots
RLS blocks a direct deletion marker outside IJ
